section.content: 本申请涉及锂离子电池技术领域，尤其是涉及一种锂离子电池，包括：第一壳体、极组以及第二壳体；其中，第一壳体和第二壳体相对接在一起，且第一壳体和第二壳体之间形成有安装凹腔，极组设置于安装凹腔。可见，将现有技术中的盖板、壳体以及底托的结构整合、设计成两个壳体的结构，也就是第一壳体和第二壳体，这样的好处在于，减少了零部件的数量，减少前期制造和后期装配的工作量，有助于降低电池的生产成本。

The application relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery, which comprises: the device comprises a first shell, a pole group and a second shell; wherein, first casing and second casing relatively link together, and be formed with the installation cavity between first casing and the second casing, the utmost point group sets up in the installation cavity. It can be seen that the integration and design of the structures of the cover plate, the housing and the bottom support in the prior art into the structure of two housings, namely the first housing and the second housing, has the advantages of reducing the number of parts, reducing the workload of early manufacturing and later assembly, and contributing to reducing the production cost of the battery.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The application relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

At present, with the increasing maturity of lithium ion battery technology, lithium ion batteries are widely applied to the fields of electric vehicles and energy storage as power batteries, and the requirements on the service performance and the safety of the lithium ion batteries are increasing. The traditional lithium ion battery generally comprises a shell, a cover plate, a pole group and the like, so that the existing lithium ion battery has the defects of various types of parts, complex manufacturing process and increased assembly procedures.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the application is to provide a lithium ion battery, solved to a certain extent that the lithium ion battery who exists generally comprises structures such as casing, apron and utmost point group among the prior art, spare part kind is many, and the preparation technology is complicated, has also increased the technical problem of assembly process.

The application provides a lithium ion battery, including: the device comprises a first shell, a pole group and a second shell; the first shell and the second shell are oppositely connected together, an installation cavity is formed between the first shell and the second shell, and the pole group is arranged in the installation cavity.

In the above technical solution, further, the first shell is formed with a first cavity and a first opening communicated with the first cavity, and a first flange is formed on an edge of the first opening of the first shell;

a second cavity and a second opening communicated with the second cavity are formed in the second shell, and a second flanging is formed on the edge of the second opening of the second shell;

the first flanging and the second flanging are oppositely connected together.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, the first flange and the second flange are connected by welding.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, the first housing and the second housing are both square housings.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, a volume ratio of the pole group to the first housing is 40-60;

the volume ratio of the pole group to the second shell is 40-60;

the volume ratio of the first shell to the second shell is 0.5-3.0.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, a height ratio of the pole group to the first housing is 0.8-2.0;

the height ratio of the pole group to the second shell is 0.5-1.0;

the height ratio of the first shell to the second shell is 3.0-8.0.

In any one of the above technical solutions, the lithium ion battery further includes two first insulating members disposed in the cavity of the first housing, and the two first insulating members are disposed on two sides of the pole group along a length direction of the pole group, and are used for separating the tab of the pole group from the first housing.

In any one of the above technical solutions, further, a liquid injection hole communicating with the cavity is formed in a side wall of the first case extending in the width direction thereof, and a through hole communicating the liquid injection hole and the inside of the pole group is formed in the first insulating member provided near the liquid injection hole;

the lithium ion battery also comprises a liquid injection hole cover which covers the liquid injection hole.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, a first inner insulating layer is disposed on an inner surface of the first housing, which is close to the second housing;

a first outer insulating layer is arranged on the inner surface, close to the first shell, of the second shell;

a second inner insulating layer is arranged on the inner surface, close to the first shell, of the second shell;

and a second outer insulating layer is arranged on the outer surface, far away from the first shell, of the second shell.

In any of the above technical solutions, further, a positive output electrode and a negative output electrode are respectively disposed at two ends of the second casing along the length direction thereof, the positive output electrode is electrically connected to the positive tab of the electrode group, and the negative output electrode is electrically connected to the negative tab of the electrode group;

second insulating components are arranged between the positive electrode lug and the second shell and between the negative electrode lug and the second shell.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effect of this application is:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery integrates the structure of apron, casing and collet among the prior art, designs into the structure of two casings, namely first casing and second casing, and such benefit lies in, has reduced the quantity of spare part, reduces the work load of manufacturing in earlier stage and later stage assembly, helps reducing the manufacturing cost of battery.

In addition, the first shell and the second shell are designed to be of structures which are beneficial to reducing the thickness and improving the capacity of the pole group, namely the energy density of the battery.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the detailed description of the present application or the technical solutions in the prior art, the drawings needed to be used in the detailed description of the present application or the prior art description will be briefly introduced below, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are some embodiments of the present application, and other drawings can be obtained by those skilled in the art without creative efforts.

fig. 2 is a schematic view of an assembly structure of a lithium ion battery provided in an embodiment of the present application;

fig. 3 is a schematic view of another assembly structure of a lithium ion battery provided in an embodiment of the present application;

fig. 4 is a schematic structural diagram of a first housing according to an embodiment of the present disclosure;

Reference numerals are as follows:

1-a first shell, 11-a liquid injection hole, 12-a first flanging, 13-a mounting groove, 2-a pole group, 3-a first insulating component, 31-a via hole, 4-a liquid injection hole cover, 5-a second shell, 51-a second flanging, 6-a positive output pole, 7-a negative output pole and 8-a second insulating component.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions of the present application will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, and it should be understood that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present application, but not all embodiments.

The components of the embodiments of the present application, generally described and illustrated in the figures herein, can be arranged and designed in a wide variety of different configurations. Thus, the following detailed description of the embodiments of the present application, presented in the accompanying drawings, is not intended to limit the scope of the claimed application, but is merely representative of selected embodiments of the application.

All other embodiments obtained by a person of ordinary skill in the art based on the embodiments in the present application without making any creative effort belong to the protection scope of the present application.

In the description of the present application, it should be noted that the terms "center", "upper", "lower", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "inner", "outer", and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on orientations or positional relationships shown in the drawings, and are only for convenience of description and simplification of description, but do not indicate or imply that the device or element referred to must have a particular orientation, be constructed in a particular orientation, and operate, and thus should not be construed as limiting the present application. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," and "third" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

In the description of the present application, it is to be noted that, unless otherwise explicitly specified or limited, the terms "mounted," "connected," and "connected" are to be construed broadly, e.g., as meaning either a fixed connection, a removable connection, or an integral connection; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present application can be understood in a specific case by those of ordinary skill in the art.

Lithium ion batteries according to some embodiments of the present application are described below with reference to fig. 1-10.

Referring to fig. 1 to 10, an embodiment of the present application provides a lithium ion battery including: a first housing 1, a second housing 5, and a pole group 2;

the first shell 1 and the second shell 5 are oppositely connected together, an installation concave cavity is formed between the first shell 1 and the second shell 5, and the pole group 2 is arranged in the installation concave cavity.

Based on the above-described structure, the lithium ion battery provided in the present embodiment integrates and designs the structures of the cover plate, the housing, and the bottom support in the prior art into the structure of two housings, i.e., the first housing 1 and the second housing 5, which has the advantages of reducing the number of parts, reducing the workload of the early manufacturing and the later assembling, and contributing to reducing the production cost of the battery.

In addition, the first case 1 and the second case 5 are designed to have a structure that helps to reduce the thickness and increase the capacity of the electrode group 2, that is, to increase the energy density of the battery.

In this embodiment, preferably, as shown in fig. 5, 6, 8 and 9, the first housing 1 is formed with a first cavity and a first opening communicating with the first cavity, and the first opening edge of the first housing 1 is formed with a first flange 12;

the second shell 5 is provided with a second cavity and a second opening communicated with the second cavity, and a second flanging 51 is formed on the edge of the second opening of the second shell 5;

the first flange 12 and the second flange 51 are joined together in opposition and preferably joined by welding.

Based on the above-described structure, the first shell 1 and the second shell 5 are designed to have a concave cavity structure, and then both can form a structure with a thinner thickness by punch forming, so that the space occupied by both can be greatly reduced, the capacity of the electrode group 2 can be improved, and the energy density of the lithium ion battery can be improved.

In addition, design first turn-ups 12 and second turn-ups 51, draw forth the lateral part of casing with assembly parts between them, can reduce shared direction of height's space, be convenient for both relatively connect together moreover, and then help the welding process in later stage, draw forth the lateral part of casing with assembly parts between them moreover, still be difficult for by electrolyte corrosion, still avoid welding the emergence that influences main casing body part's roughness and intensity scheduling problem. Note also that the first flange 12 and the second flange 51 are formed throughout the entire openings of the first case 1 and the second case 5, respectively.

Further, the first housing 1 and the second housing 5 are preferably rectangular housings, regular in shape, easy to manufacture, and correspondingly, the pole group 2 is also rectangular.

In this embodiment, it is preferable that the volume ratio of the pole group 2 to the first housing 1 is 40 to 60;

the volume ratio of the pole group 2 to the second shell 5 is 40-60;

the volume ratio of the first shell 1 to the second shell 5 is 0.5-3.0.

According to the structure described above, with the above proportion arrangement, it can be ensured that after the first casing 1 and the second casing 5 are assembled, the mounting cavity formed inside can not only accommodate the pole group 2 and the two first insulating members 3 described below, but also no excessive gap is generated, so that the whole assembly structure is compact, and it is helpful to improve the energy density.

In this embodiment, preferably, as shown in fig. 4, 7 and 10, the height ratio H1/H2 of the pole group 2 to the first housing 1 is 0.8-2.0;

the height ratio H1/H3 of pole group 2 to second housing 5 is 0.5-1.0;

the height ratio H1/H2 of the first casing 1 to the second casing 5 is 3 to 8.

According to the structure described above, it is ensured that the pole group 2 can be accommodated in the mounting cavity formed inside after the first housing 1 and the second housing 5 are assembled, and an excessive gap is not easily generated, which contributes to reducing the overall height and miniaturization of the design.

In this embodiment, preferably, as shown in fig. 1, the lithium ion battery further includes two first insulating members 3 disposed in the cavity of the first case 1, and the two first insulating members 3 are disposed on both sides of the pole group 2 along the length direction of the pole group 2 for separating the tabs of the pole group 2 from the first case 1, and further, preferably, the first insulating members 3 are formed of pp, that is, polypropylene material.

Note that: as shown in fig. 1, 5 and 6, the L-shaped avoiding groove formed in the first insulating member 3 is designed to be matched with the mounting groove 13 of the first housing 1, because in practical use, a plurality of batteries are often required to be matched, and an electrical connection component or the like needs to be arranged between two adjacent batteries, a space for mounting the electrical connection component or the like on the batteries, that is, a structure for arranging the mounting groove 13 is required.

A side wall of the first case 1 extending in the width direction thereof is formed with an injection hole 11 communicating with the cavity, and the first insulating member 3 disposed near the injection hole 11 is formed with a via hole 31 communicating the injection hole 11 and the interior of the pole group 2, the via hole 31 and the injection hole 11 serving to inject the electrolyte into the interior of the case.

The lithium ion battery also comprises a liquid injection hole cover 4, and the liquid injection hole cover 4 is covered on the liquid injection hole 11, so that the effect of preventing the leakage of the electrolyte is achieved, and the lithium ion battery is safer and more reliable.

In this embodiment, preferably, the inner surface of the first casing 1 near the second casing 5 is provided with a first inner insulating layer;

the inner surface of the second shell 5 close to the first shell 1 is provided with a first outer insulating layer;

the inner surface of the second shell 5 close to the first shell 1 is provided with a second inner insulating layer;

the outer surface of the second housing 5 remote from the first housing 1 is provided with a second outer insulating layer.

According to the structure described above, the structure in the prior art in which the outer surface of the pole group 2 is coated with the insulating layer is changed to the structure in which the insulating layers are disposed on the inner and outer surfaces of the first casing 1 and the second casing 5, that is, before the first casing 1 and the second casing 5 are assembled in a factory, the insulating layers can be coated on the surfaces of the first casing 1 and the second casing 5 during production, so that the step of coating the outer surface of the pole group 2 with the insulating layers in the factory assembly is saved, and the working efficiency is improved.

Further, preferably, the first inner insulating layer of the first housing 1 and the second inner insulating layer of the second housing 5 are both of a bonded insulating film structure, and the insulating films are also formed by PP polypropylene material; the first outer insulating layer of the second case 5 and the second outer insulating layer of the second case 5 are insulating layers formed by spraying, and the sprayed material may be polypropylene.

In this embodiment, as shown in fig. 1 and 2, it is preferable that both ends of the second case 5 in the length direction thereof are respectively provided with a positive output electrode 6 and a negative output electrode 7, and the positive output electrode 6 is electrically connected to the positive tab of the electrode group 2, the negative output electrode 7 is electrically connected to the negative tab of the electrode group 2, and the positive output electrode 6 and the negative output electrode 7 serve as a medium electrically connected to the outside, and output electric energy to the outside.

Further, it is preferable that second insulating members 8 are provided between the positive electrode tab and the negative electrode tab of the tab and the second case 5, as shown in fig. 9, and further, it is preferable that the second insulating members 8 are also formed of PP, that is, polypropylene material.

Finally, it should be noted that: the above embodiments are only used to illustrate the technical solutions of the present application, and not to limit the same; although the present application has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, those of ordinary skill in the art will understand that: the technical solutions described in the foregoing embodiments may still be modified, or some or all of the technical features may be equivalently replaced; and the modifications or the substitutions do not make the essence of the corresponding technical solutions depart from the scope of the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present application.
